roles.cause: Possessing a strong and bold writer's voice while remaining weak and soft as a person
roles.effect: Creation of a crack (裂痕) or frenzy between one's writing and one's living

conditions: When writing practice is not integrated with daily ethical living

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: The contrast between bold artistic expression and timid personal behavior

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-2

roles.instance: Hemingway writing Santiago with infinite patience while himself being abusive and alcoholic outside the study
roles.concept: 裂痕 (the crack between writing and living)
roles.detail: Illustrates the disconnect between artistic portrayal of virtue and lived ethical failure

conditions: When analyzing the relationship between an author's work and personal conduct

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Santiago's patience vs Hemingway's domestic abuse

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-3

roles.theory: Writing about infinite patience and virtue (as Hemingway did through Santiago)
roles.reality: The author fails to embody these qualities in daily life (abuse, alcoholism)
roles.implication: Writing alone does not constitute ethical living; the two must be unified

conditions: When writers believe artistic expression substitutes for ethical behavior

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Hemingway's Santiago portrayal vs his personal life

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-4

roles.statement: Art is action that does not harm others (艺术是不侵犯他人的行为)
roles.implication: This art must be practiced not only on the page but in daily life
roles.scope: All interactions and behaviors, not just creative output

conditions: When defining what constitutes true artistic practice

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Bringing the non-harming quality of writing into kitchen and street interactions

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-5

roles.situation: When there is a gap between one's writing (full of love for the world) and one's living (careless or neglectful)
roles.action: Practice the art of non-harm in daily life; take poetry from the desk into the kitchen and beyond
roles.rationale: To heal the crack and unify the writer's existence with their artistic expression

conditions: For writers who write with passion but live carelessly

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Instead of rushing home after writing, let the whole day be the poem

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-6

roles.instance: The Monday gathering with Kate: cold feet, smoking, feeding cats, friendship, filling ashtrays
roles.concept: 把诗带到书桌以外 (taking poetry beyond the desk)
roles.detail: The whole day itself was a good poem, not just the twenty-minute writing sessions

conditions: When practicing writing as integrated living rather than separate activity

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 绵绵的友情，冰冷的脚丫子，喂猫，用烟蒂填满烟灰缸 - the ordinary moments as poetry

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-7

roles.statement: Our goal is to hold goodwill toward all sentient beings in every moment of our lives (一辈子时时刻刻都要对一切有知觉的存在怀抱善念)
roles.implication: Writing well does not grant license to behave poorly in traffic or daily interactions
roles.scope: Every moment of existence, from writing desk to grocery store

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Not cursing your car or speeding after writing a good poem

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-8

roles.statement: We write because we love the world (我们写作是因为我们热爱这个世界)
roles.implication: This love must extend beyond writing to all physical spaces and actions; the body must complete the secret
roles.scope: The fundamental motivation for all authentic writing

conditions: When seeking the deepest reason for writing practice

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Walking into living rooms, porches, backyards, and grocery stores with embodied love

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-9

roles.cause: Writing because we love the world (the innermost secret)
roles.effect: Manifestation of this love through physical presence in ordinary spaces (living room, porch, grocery store)

conditions: When the internal motivation for writing is love

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Using our bodies to complete the secret in the vegetable grocery store

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-10

roles.method_a: Writing for love of the world (primary motivation)
roles.method_b: Writing for payment and recognition (external rewards)
roles.difference: Love is essential and secret; payment/recognition are secondary benefits that are nice but not the core reason
roles.when_to_use: Always write from love; accept payment/recognition when they come but never make them the goal

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Continuing to write despite meager pay and minimal magazine recognition

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-more-about-mondays-再谈星期一-0-11

roles.property: Strong and bold (强劲又大胆)

conditions: When writers are in their creative element

examples: The powerful voice expressed on the page

roles.term: 令人心动的留白 (sensation of space)

roles.goal: internalize short poetry form and train rapid poetic thinking
steps: select ten visual objects as titles (e.g., glass, salt, water)
write continuously for ten rounds
each round: write for exactly three minutes
each poem: exactly three lines
write quickly without thinking or stopping
rest briefly between each poem
roles.context: when learning to write short form poetry like haiku

conditions: beginning practice with short poetry forms

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-a-sensation-of-space-令人心动的留白-0-2

roles.situation: wanting to write in a specific literary form (novel, short story, poetry)
roles.action: read extensively in that form until its structure, pacing, sentence patterns, and scene-setting techniques become deeply embedded in your body and mind
roles.rationale: once the form is internalized through digestion, it will emerge naturally when you sit down to write without conscious effort

conditions: transitioning between forms (e.g., poet to novelist)

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: novelists learning complete sentences and steady scene-setting; poets learning to jump between images

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-a-sensation-of-space-令人心动的留白-0-3

roles.situation: wanting to master a complex skill or art form
roles.action: model experts who have practiced for thirty years by studying their belief systems, mental structures (order of thinking), and physiology (how they stand, breathe, and hold their body)
roles.rationale: by embodying the expert completely, you transcend your own limitations and can perform beyond your current capability, like breaking through wooden boards without hesitation

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Tony Robbins' fire walking method
becoming the karate black belt master when striking boards

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-a-sensation-of-space-令人心动的留白-0-4

roles.theory: Haiku must follow the 5-7-5 syllable structure (17 syllables total) with five syllables in the first line, seven in the second, and five in the third.
roles.reality: English haiku should simply be three short lines because Japanese syllables carry significantly more meaning than English syllables; R.H. Blyth's translations of masters like Basho and Issa do not follow syllable count.
roles.implication: In English, focus on capturing the essence and the 'sensation of space' rather than counting syllables mechanically.

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Blyth's translations of Basho, Issa, Shiki, and Buson

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-a-sensation-of-space-令人心动的留白-0-5

roles.statement: Form alone does not constitute art; form must be infused with life and essence.

conditions: moving beyond technical proficiency to mastery

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: writing three-minute poems until the three-line structure feels natural

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-a-sensation-of-space-令人心动的留白-0-8

roles.transition: from practitioner to recognized poet to master status

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

roles.situation: 发现自己在机械性写作，只是尽责任地填时间，没有情感投入，纯粹照章行事
roles.action: 停止写作一段时间（一周或一年），直到内心渴望表达、觉得不吐不快时再回来写作

roles.cause: 写作时没有把心放进去，只是机械性地推着笔横过纸上，尽责了事
roles.effect: 浪费能量且无法进步，因为人在没有情感投入的情况下照章行事需要花费很大的力气，这种做法不啻在浪费能量

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

roles.rationale: 这样可以体会自己的节奏，了解自己何时需要写、何时需要休息，让自己和自己的关系更加深刻，而不是盲目地依循规则

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

roles.concept: 感受当下情境胜过事前自我设限和盲目遵守规则

以手写口，使用口语化文字，不求华丽

roles.action: 多看看自己的作品，承认那的确是我们自己的作品，并挺身拥护它
roles.rationale: 这能慢慢消除真实本性与意识能力之间的盲目落差，学会接纳自己正是当下那个具有创造力的好人

conditions: 收到正面反馈却无法内化时

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-claim-your-writing-承认你写的东西-0-9

roles.trigger: 承认自己写出佳作并认可它
roles.mechanism: 消除真实本性与看出真实本性的意识能力之间的盲目落差，将自我意念与作品联结
roles.outcome: 获得内在丰美带来的宁静与信心，感到满足，并有动力继续写作

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-claim-your-writing-承认你写的东西-0-10

roles.statement: 这世界承认它好，哪有我们自己承认它好来得重要
roles.implication: 自我认可是创作满足感和持续写作的关键，比外界赞誉更能带来深层的宁静与信心
roles.scope: 创作评价，心理满足

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-claim-your-writing-承认你写的东西-0-11

roles.situation: 面对自己的写作质量与自我价值关系时，避免陷入"作品烂=我烂"、"作品好=我烂"、"作品烂=我好"的虚假二分法
roles.action: 认识到"我们很好，因此我们有能力挣脱抗拒的心理，从而发光发热，写出佳作，并承认那的确是我们自己的作品"
roles.rationale: 内在的丰美与自我意念一旦和作品联结，便可带给艺术家宁静与信心，消除自我否定

conditions: 区分作品与自我价值时

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-claim-your-writing-承认你写的东西-0-12

roles.cause: 突破抗拒心态
roles.effect: 写出情感真挚又深刻的作品

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-trust-yourself-信任自己-0-0

roles.instance: The author's poem about windows that every listener dismissed as terrible but she considered great
roles.concept: Trusting your own artistic judgment despite unanimous external criticism
roles.detail: The author maintains confidence in the work even when everyone else disparages it, planning to highlight it in a Nobel Prize speech

conditions: When receiving negative feedback on creative work
When external opinion contradicts internal valuation

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 我有首关于窗户的诗，凡是听到的人都断然表示烂透了，我却认为那是首很棒的诗

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-trust-yourself-信任自己-0-1

roles.instance: Students extracting at least four different versions of a poem from the same two diary pages
roles.concept: Multiple valid interpretations can emerge from the same source material
roles.detail: Different students selected different segments (beginning, middle, accidentally photocopied overlaid text) and all produced poems with good rhythm, including one line everyone chose: 'Wherever you go, you are the hills of New Mexico'

conditions: When analyzing raw material for poetic potential

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 有五六位学生自愿找诗，结果找到了至少四种版本的诗；有些诗包含了日记一开头的前半段，有些包含了中段，甚至有位学生挑中了不小心影印上去的一些叠印的作品

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-trust-yourself-信任自己-0-2

roles.situation: When uncertain about the quality of a piece of writing
roles.action: Set the work aside and re-read it after six months
roles.rationale: Time provides clearer perspective and judgment; temporal distance clarifies artistic vision

conditions: When experiencing doubt about a manuscript or poem
When unable to judge work objectively

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 要是你对某件作品没有把握，就暂且搁置一段时间，六个月以后再重看，届时想法会比较清楚

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-trust-yourself-信任自己-0-3

roles.situation: When receiving opinions from others about your writing
roles.action: Listen to others' views and take them in without building walls, then make your own decision
roles.rationale: It is your poem and your voice; there are no absolute rules, only your relationship with yourself and what you want to say

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 你应该听听别人的看法，而且要听进去，（别在自己四周围起铜墙铁壁。）然后做出自己的决定

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-trust-yourself-信任自己-0-4

roles.statement: The deep relationship between you and yourself is crucial because submitting work to 100 people yields 100 different opinions
roles.implication: You must maintain sovereignty and internal authority over your work while remaining permeable to input
roles.scope: Creative writing and artistic decision-making

conditions: When navigating between self-trust and external feedback

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 把一件作品交给一百个人，很可能会得到一百个不同的意见，不见得有天壤之别，可是还是很不一样

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-trust-yourself-信任自己-0-5

roles.statement: Presenting yourself nakedly in work means relaxing control, which is good; freezing yourself to avoid exposure causes more pain than the discomfort of exposure
roles.implication: Authenticity requires vulnerability and surrendering control; defensive rigidity is more harmful than the risk of revelation
roles.scope: Authentic creative expression

conditions: When deciding how much to reveal in writing
When feeling exposed by authentic writing

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 在作品中赤裸裸地呈现自己，不啻放松控制，这是件好事
把整个人冻结起来，丝毫也不肯暴露，却让人更加痛苦

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-trust-yourself-信任自己-0-6

roles.trigger: Creating a work that, upon re-reading after six months, appears to be bad or weak
roles.mechanism: The excellent parts of that work decompose into compost (堆肥)
roles.outcome: New beautiful things will grow from that composted material

conditions: When disappointed by the quality of past work
When recycling old material into new creative work

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 你的堆肥中优秀的那一部分已经分解了，将会生出美好的事物，请保持耐心

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-0

roles.meaning: A metaphor for ruthless editorial honesty and the willingness to cut weak writing without mercy; not about cruelty but about having the toughness to face truth and eliminate what lacks vital energy

conditions: When separating creator from editor roles

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: 痛下杀手 (ruthless cutting/killing) as described by Tom

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-1

roles.method_b: 日本武士的天地 (The Samurai Realm)
roles.difference: The Creative Pool is nurturing, encouraging, and tolerant, focused on initial thoughts and generation; the Samurai Realm is harsh, honest, and eliminative, focused on cutting what lacks energy
roles.when_to_use: Use the Creative Pool for first drafts and initial generation; use the Samurai approach for editing and assessment of completed work

conditions: When distinguishing between drafting and editing phases

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Natalie being encouraging in class because they are in the creative pool together
Switching to Samurai mode when reviewing Tom's finished piece

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-2

roles.situation: When reviewing a poem or piece where only some lines or sections contain energy
roles.action: Cut everything except the line(s) with energy; keep only what transmits life and vitality
roles.rationale: Poetry and prose should carry vitality; every line should be vivid and powerful. If only one line has energy, that line is the true poem

conditions: When assessing poetic or prose energy

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: William Carlos Williams advising Allen Ginsberg: 'If there is only one line with energy in the poem, cut everything else and keep only that line'

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-3

roles.statement: Truth ultimately does not harm; it makes the world clearer and verses more radiant (真相到头来并不会害人；真相使得这世界变得更清楚分明，诗句更光华耀目)
roles.implication: Honest editorial assessment, even when ruthless, improves the work and clarifies rather than destroys
roles.scope: Editorial critique and self-assessment in writing

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-4

roles.situation: When encountering bad writing that lacks energy or vitality (a 'dead horse')
roles.action: Do not spend excessive time critiquing it; briefly acknowledge it is not working and move on to other work
roles.rationale: The writer will write other things; beating a dead horse wastes time and prevents progress. There is already enough mediocre writing in the world

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Spending twenty minutes criticizing a bad poem is like beating a dead horse to make it run again
Mark Van Doren stopping literary criticism because 'Why spend time discussing what you don't like?'

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-5

roles.goal: Identify and preserve only the writing that 'fully burns' with energy while eliminating lifeless prose
steps: Locate where the energy exists in the piece
Assess whether it 'fully burns' or merely has potential
If it does not fully burn, treat it as compost for future seeds and move on quickly (do not over-polish)
Keep only what transmits life, carries vitality, and radiates light
roles.context: When work is nearly complete and ready for honest editorial assessment

conditions: When the editor is 'floating above the mental fog' and can see clearly

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Tom's third paragraph: acknowledged as having energy but not fully burning, treated as compost for future seeds, then moving on after three minutes

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-6

roles.cause: Someone reads work that is energetic and 'fully burning' with vitality
roles.effect: Everyone in the room becomes excited and energized; the writing wakes up and stimulates everyone's vitality

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Natalie observing that when someone reads energetic work in class, everyone gets excited

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-7

roles.entity: Good writing that should be kept
roles.property: Fully burns with energy (充分燃烧), transmits life, carries vitality, radiates light, and comes from initial thoughts/first mind (初始意念)

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Work that makes everyone excited when read aloud

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-8

roles.property: Lukewarm (温温吞吞), not fully burning, lacking energy, like a dead horse (死马)

conditions: When identifying writing that should be cut

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Writing that makes people drowsy
Writing that requires 'beating' to improve

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-9

roles.theory: Teachers should always be encouraging and find something good in every piece of writing; critics should help fix weak work
roles.reality: Some writing is simply dead (死马) and should not be nurtured or fixed; honest cutting and acknowledging lack of energy is necessary for growth
roles.implication: Writers should separate creative and editorial phases, apply ruthless honesty during editing, and abandon weak work without guilt rather than over-polishing lifeless prose

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Students wanting Natalie to be more critical during creation phase
Natalie refusing to mix the creative pool with editorial混战

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-10

roles.instance: Tom's third paragraph in his distributed piece
roles.concept: Writing that has some energy but does not fully burn
roles.detail: It can be played with briefly and composted for future seeds, but should not be overworked; the writer should move on after brief acknowledgment

conditions: When assessing work that has potential but isn't quite alive

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-11

roles.situation: When deciding what writing to critique, discuss, or spend time on
roles.action: Do not spend time discussing or critiquing work you do not like or that lacks energy
roles.rationale: Time is limited; energy should be directed toward what has life and potential rather than attempting to resuscitate dead work

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Mark Van Doren stopping literary criticism: 'Why spend time discussing what you don't like?'

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-the-samurai-日本武士-0-12

roles.trigger: Trying to create and edit simultaneously (mixing creator and editor roles)
roles.mechanism: Stirring the creative pool with editorial judgment creates chaos, fear, and confusion; the writer tries to create while simultaneously judging the work
roles.outcome: Stagnation, inability to write freely, and terrifying creative blocks

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Students trying to pull Natalie into the '混战' (chaotic battle) of mixed roles

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-i-don-t-want-to-die-我不想死-0-0

roles.instance: Suzuki Roshi's final words 'I don't want to die'
roles.concept: authentic expression of true feelings without pretense
roles.detail: Instead of offering profound Zen teachings or references to Great Emptiness expected from a dying master, he simply stated his honest feeling about not wanting to die

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-i-don-t-want-to-die-我不想死-0-1

roles.instance: Suzuki Roshi
roles.category: Zen master, founder of San Francisco Zen Center, and author of 'Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind'

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-i-don-t-want-to-die-我不想死-0-2

roles.property: Manifest vitality and life force (生命力)

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-i-don-t-want-to-die-我不想死-0-3

roles.property: Manifest peace and serenity (祥和之气)

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-i-don-t-want-to-die-我不想死-0-4

roles.property: Contains underlying infinite vitality and spontaneous action (无穷的活力和自发精神) within it

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-i-don-t-want-to-die-我不想死-0-5

roles.trigger: Artists expressing vitality without underlying peace or serenity
roles.mechanism: Lack of balancing peaceful foundation to contain the creative energy
roles.outcome: Self-immolation manifesting as alcohol addiction, suicide, and mental illness

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-i-don-t-want-to-die-我不想死-0-6

roles.situation: When writing with intense creative energy and burning life force
roles.action: Ground this expression in a place of inner peace and serenity
roles.rationale: Prevents excited distraction and inability to complete stories; avoids the self-immolation seen in artists who lack inner peace

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-i-don-t-want-to-die-我不想死-0-7

roles.statement: At moments of truth (including death and writing), express simple honest feelings like 'I don't want to die' without anger, self-blame, or self-pity
roles.implication: Accepting the true self in this way allows one to touch the fundamental driving force behind writing and maintain practice regardless of circumstances
roles.scope: Authentic writing practice and facing mortality

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-0

roles.statement: Anything requiring total commitment is a lonely journey
roles.implication: No matter how supportive friends are, they cannot share your exact emotional state or fully understand your specific experience; you must accept this solitude
roles.scope: Deep creative work and total dedication to craft

conditions: When fully committed to a creative project
During the final phases of intensive work

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Writing a book where you cannot expect others to feel the same excitement or understand what you've been through

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-1

roles.instance: Natalie Goldberg finishing 'Writing Down the Bones' at 11 PM on Sunday, feeling angry, disoriented, and believing the book has nothing to do with her life, then going alone to Lone Wolf cafe for wine and ice cream
roles.concept: Being used by the muse
roles.detail: The sensation that the work came through you rather than from you, leaving you feeling utilized and empty upon completion

conditions: Upon completing a major creative work

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Feeling the book is complete but having no relation to it, unable to connect it to daily needs like finding a lover or brushing teeth

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-2

roles.meaning: The experience of creative work being driven by forces beyond one's conscious control, resulting in feelings of being utilized, possessed, or emptied during and after the creative process

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Miriam describing Natalie's experience as 'being used by the muse'

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-3

roles.meaning: Overcoming the fear of success and the fear of failure, rather than the physical or technical act of writing itself

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Spending a year and a half writing where the battle was internal against fear, not the writing itself

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-4

roles.trigger: Fear of success and fear of failure
roles.mechanism: Total immersion and burning through the fear via continuous, relentless work until the fear exhausts itself
roles.outcome: Pure action without hesitation, resistance, or psychological burden

conditions: When paralyzed by fear of outcome

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Writing seven days a week for the last month and a half, immediately moving from chapter to chapter

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-5

roles.situation: In the final phase of completing a major creative work
roles.action: Write continuously seven days a week, moving immediately from one chapter to the next, while ignoring all bodily demands for comfort, socializing, food cravings, or daydreaming
roles.rationale: Maintaining uninterrupted momentum burns through resistance and distractions, allowing total immersion necessary to complete the work

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Ignoring the parts of the body screaming for ice cream, friends, or daydreaming during the last month and a half of writing

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-6

roles.theory: Success brings happiness, validation, and fulfillment
roles.reality: Success may bring loneliness, isolation, disappointment, and emotional emptiness
roles.implication: Writers should prepare for complex, potentially negative emotions upon completion rather than expecting pure celebration

conditions: After completing a major creative work

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Crying the morning after finishing the book despite feeling light and happy the night before
Wanting to jump off the Empire State Building after completion

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-7

roles.situation: After completing a major creative work and experiencing unexpected emotions
roles.action: Give yourself space to feel whatever arises—whether anger, emptiness, joy, or despair—without judging these feelings as inappropriate or invalid
roles.rationale: Success brings complex, varied emotional responses that are normal and must be accepted; there is no 'correct' way to feel

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Allowing yourself to cry the morning after finishing, or to feel angry, or to feel nothing

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-8

roles.statement: Publication and external validation are fine but should not be overly important
roles.implication: Focusing on publication can derail or intoxicate the writer; the imperative is to continue writing regardless of external success or failure
roles.scope: Professional writing life and creative practice

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Katagiri Roshi advising not to let publication go to your head
Telling yourself after finishing: 'You'll start another one'

atoms.id: 写出我心-普通人如何通过写作表达自己-inferred-epilogue-结语-0-9

roles.situation: Upon completing a book or major creative work
roles.action: Immediately commit to beginning the next work; continue the practice without pause
roles.rationale: Completion is not an endpoint but part of an ongoing practice; external validation is fleeting while the work itself remains the constant

source.title: 写出我心:普通人如何通过写作表达自己

examples: Telling yourself 'This book is done, you will start another one'
Continuing to write regardless of the desire to jump off the Empire State Building
